status.description: completed: a definite answer. completed_with_assumptions: an answer that depends on assumptions listed under assumptions. stopped: no answer; explain why under issues.

results.description: The quantities requested in task.md, under exactly the keys it names. Empty if stopped.

exclusions.description: Samples, specimens or values left out of the analysis, each with its reason.

issues.description: Problems or ambiguities found in the materials, and how each was handled.

summary.description: A short account of what was done.
